'''Bad Deck Breakdowns''' ('''BDBD''') is a ''Star Wars'' CCG podcast hosted by [[Kendall Halman]] (forum name Corran) and [[Matt Lutz]], part of the KendallCast Network. It released 30 episodes from 5 September 2019 to 30 April 2023, with audio on the Internet Archive.<ref name="ia-kendall">[https://archive.org/search?query=creator%3A%22Kendall+Halman%22 Kendall Halman uploads], Internet Archive (audio items, 2019–2026).</ref> Most episodes break down one deliberately unusual or underpowered deck, with the full decklist in the episode notes; others are interviews or tournament reports. [[David Woods]] joined as co-host with episode 25 (October 2021).<ref name="ia25">[https://archive.org/details/25-tdigwatt-trooper-beats Bad Deck Breakdowns - 25 - TDIGWATT Trooper Beats], Kendall Halman, Internet Archive (20 October 2021).</ref>

The first episode introduced the show as "a new Star Wars CCG Podcast from Kendall Halman and Matt Lutz".<ref name="ia1">[https://archive.org/details/1thisgalaxymayneedapodcast Bad Deck Breakdowns - 1 - This Galaxy May Need A Podcast], Kendall Halman, Internet Archive (5 September 2019).</ref> Kendall later started the interview podcast [[Corran on the Horn]] (2022) and the game-show podcast [[Top 8 with Corran and Batmouse]] (2023).
